svg.aria-label: Natural harmonics on the violin A string: touching at 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 and 1/5 of the string splits it into 2, 3, 4 and 5 vibrating parts, sounding A5, E6, A6 and C sharp 7
svg.text: Natural harmonics: touch a node, the string splits
Touch lightly (do not press) at 1/n of the string: it vibrates in n equal parts and sounds higher.
Diamond = where the finger touches. The loops show the parts of the string that move; the pinch points do not move.
